entities.name: Joanna
entities.description: A screenwriter and one of the two speakers, a long-standing friend of Nate's; he calls her Jo. Between January and November 2022 she finished three screenplays, co-wrote Finding Home with her writers group, wrote a book, saw work she had contributed to reach the big screen three times, and began filming her own road-trip screenplay. She is allergic to reptiles, furred animals and cockroaches, and lactose intolerant, so she bakes dairy-free; she hikes, used to act, and formerly lived in Michigan.

entities.name: Nate
entities.description: A competitive video gamer and the other speaker, a long-standing friend of Joanna's. Over 2022 he won tournaments in CS:GO, Street Fighter and Valorant, an international tournament in August and a big-money one in October, and turned gaming into a living; by November he was weighing offers from new teams and had started a YouTube gaming channel. He keeps turtles and a dog called Max, makes dairy-free and vegan desserts, presented a cooking show, and dyed his hair a bright bold colour in April 2022.

entities.name: Joanna's brother
entities.description: Joanna's brother, who wrote her notes and letters when they were children. One of those letters was included at the beginning of the introduction to the film script she was writing in November 2022. Never named in the conversation.

entities.name: Nate's turtles

properties.aliases: the little ones; these little guys; my little dudes; my little buddies; these critters

entities.description: Nate's pet turtles, never given names in the conversation and referred to as his little ones, little guys and little dudes. He had two of them from about 2019 and added a third from a pet store by 9 November 2022, once their new and larger tank was big enough. He walks them, takes them to the park and to the beach at Tampa, sometimes brings them into the kitchen while he cooks, and says they eat vegetables, fruit and insects; one is adventurous and one reserved. He has liked turtles since he was a boy and calls them zen masters who keep him calm before tournaments.

entities.name: Max
entities.description: Nate's adopted dog, who joined the household shortly before 20 May 2022. Full of energy, he keeps Nate's turtles active; while walking him Nate met a couple living nearby with a dog of their own and arranged dog playdates with them.

entities.name: Tilly, Joanna's childhood dog
entities.description: A dog Joanna had when she lived in Michigan, before she developed her animal allergy and the family had to give her up. Joanna named the stuffed toy dog Nate gave her after this dog, because the name reminds her of when she could hold animals without reacting.

entities.name: Tilly the stuffed dog
entities.description: A stuffed toy dog Nate gave Joanna on 25 May 2022 as a stand-in for the pet her allergies rule out. She named her Tilly, after the dog she had in Michigan, and keeps her nearby while writing; she said in October 2022 that Tilly helps her stay focused. Referred to as the new pup, the stuffed animal and Tilly.

entities.name: Nate's gaming setup
entities.description: Nate's dedicated gaming room at home, with a computer, gaming chair, monitors and headphones. He was looking after it in May 2022 and upgraded the equipment shortly before 7 November 2022. He practises and competes there, plays with friends, and calls it both his haven and a necessity for his career. Referred to as his gaming room, his set-up and his equipment.

entities.name: Michigan
entities.description: The US state where Joanna lived earlier in her life and where she had her dog Tilly, before she developed her animal allergy.

entities.name: Woodhaven
entities.description: A small town in the Midwest that Joanna visited on a road trip in early July 2022 as research for her next film. She saw its scenery and historic buildings and found a book from the 1900s of stories and sketches about the town in its library; its past and how much it had changed sparked ideas for her next script.

entities.name: Whispering Falls
entities.description: A waterfall Joanna photographed on one of the trails she found in her town in May 2022. She described it as peaceful and serene and said the rush of the water and the beauty of the place made her calm and present.

entities.name: Fort Wayne
entities.description: The city Joanna was hiking near in the summer of 2022 when she took a photograph of a sunflower field at sunset, which she showed Nate on 9 November 2022.

entities.name: Tampa
entities.description: The city where Nate took his turtles to the beach on 10 November 2022.

entities.name: Joanna's writers group
entities.description: The writers group Joanna joined on 21 April 2022, whose members she said inspired her, understood her writing and made her feel she belonged. She works on the script Finding Home with them, shared her book with them in August 2022 and got good feedback, and made a bookmark in October 2022 for one of the women in it. She calls it both her writers group and her writing club.

entities.name: Nate's vegan diet group
entities.description: A vegan diet group Nate belongs to. He made vegan ice cream on 17 June 2022 and shared it with its members.

entities.name: Writing
entities.description: Joanna's craft and livelihood: screenwriting above all, plus a book, a blog, a journal and written-down memories. She calls it an escape, a way to express feelings and a means of creating worlds, and says she writes best when she is being true to herself. Nature and hiking inspire it; she keeps a shelf of books and magazines as her source of inspiration and a cork board of quotes and photographs. Nate asked her for writing advice in March 2022 and she told him to read widely, write, share and gather feedback.

entities.name: Hiking
entities.description: Joanna's outdoor pursuit, which she says resets her and inspires her writing. She found a trail in her hometown on 16 April 2022, more trails in her town in May 2022 including Whispering Falls, and by then called herself an expert hiker; she planned a trail with a waterfall with friends for the weekend of 4 and 5 June 2022 and hiked near Fort Wayne in the summer. Nate is not a hiker but agreed he might come along.

entities.name: Acting
entities.description: Joanna's first passion, before writing. She was so nervous in her first play that she forgot her lines, which taught her to prepare and stay in the moment. By April 2022 she considered writing her strength but said she might return to acting one day.

entities.name: Competitive video gaming
entities.description: Nate's pursuit and, by mid-2022, his job. He won his first tournament in January 2022 playing CS:GO with a team, a local Street Fighter tournament in late April, a regional one in late May, an online fourth in July, an international one in August, a big-money one in early October and a Valorant final on 5 November. He also had setbacks in September and November. He plays for fun rather than to win, prefers the less competitive players, coaches others, organised a gaming party and went to a game convention.

entities.name: Making dairy-free desserts
entities.description: The craft both speakers share. Nate discovered coconut milk ice cream in February 2022 and went on to make vegan ice cream for his diet group, teach others, and present it on his own cooking show; his recipe is coconut milk, vanilla extract, sugar and a pinch of salt, churned after chilling. Joanna, who is lactose intolerant, bakes dairy-free cakes, tarts, cupcakes, cookies and pies with almond flour, coconut oil and almond or coconut milk, for friends and family. They swap recipes throughout the conversation.

entities.name: Joanna's animal allergy
entities.description: Joanna's severe allergy to most reptiles and to animals with fur, and — as she discovered shortly before March 2022 — to cockroaches. Her face becomes puffy and itchy around certain animals, so she has always avoided them; it is why her family gave up her dog Tilly in Michigan, why she cannot keep a pet, and why she can only watch Nate's turtles from a distance.

entities.name: Joanna's lactose intolerance
entities.description: Joanna cannot have dairy, which is why she asks Nate for dairy-free recipes and bakes with coconut or almond milk. Stated as not being able to have dairy in February 2022 and as lactose intolerance in April 2022.

entities.name: Nate's cooking show
entities.description: Nate's own cooking show, on which he taught vegan ice cream recipes on 12 September 2022. He found it nerve-wracking to put himself out there but enjoyed it and picked up new recipes; his favourite dish from it is coconut milk ice cream.

entities.name: Nate's YouTube gaming channel
entities.description: Gaming content Nate started making for YouTube in November 2022, to entertain people and satisfy his appetite for games between tournaments. He is a fan of such videos himself and hoped to connect with others through it; Joanna advised him to study other creators' videos first, which he was already doing.

entities.name: Counter-Strike: Global Offensive
entities.description: The team shooter Nate won his first video game tournament in, in the week before 21 January 2022, playing with a team. It remained his usual game into May 2022.

entities.name: Street Fighter
entities.description: The fighting game Nate plays a lot with friends. He entered a local Street Fighter tournament in the week before 2 May 2022 instead of his usual CS:GO, and won it — his second tournament win.

entities.name: Valorant
entities.description: The game of the big tournament Nate reached the final of and won on 5 November 2022, which he called the best feeling.

entities.name: Cyberpunk 2077
entities.description: A game Nate was playing constantly around October 2022, for its futuristic setting and gameplay.

entities.name: Xenoblade Chronicles
entities.description: A Japanese fantasy RPG Nate was playing in November 2022 and recommended to Joanna. He had wanted to play it for a while because friends recommended it, and he is a big fan of Nintendo games.

entities.name: Catan
entities.description: A strategy board game about building settlements and trading resources that Nate loves. He played it with people he met at the game convention on 7 October 2022 and says it can be played either competitively or in a relaxed way.

entities.name: The Lord of the Rings trilogy
entities.description: Nate's favourite film trilogy, which he admires for its world building, battles and storytelling and calls probably the greatest trilogy of all time. He first mentioned it unnamed on 21 April 2022 and Joanna named it when she watched it on his recommendation on 1 May 2022 and thought it awesome.

entities.name: Little Women
entities.description: The film Joanna recommended to Nate on 7 February 2022, calling it a great story about sisterhood, love and reaching for your dreams. Nate watched it shortly before 6 October 2022 and thought the acting and story were great.

entities.name: Inception
entities.description: A film Nate watched shortly before 9 October 2022, which he said blew his mind with its twists and dream premise.

entities.name: Joanna's favourite romantic drama

properties.aliases: the romantic drama about memory and relationships

entities.description: A romantic drama about memory and relationships that is one of Joanna's favourite films; never named in the conversation. She first watched it about three years before January 2022, bought a physical copy on DVD, has seen it several times, and recommended it to Nate on 21 January 2022 for its idea and its acting.

entities.name: Joanna's first screenplay
entities.description: Joanna's first full screenplay, a mix of drama and romance, which she finished and printed on 21 January 2022 after working on it for a long time. She submitted it to film festivals hoping producers and directors would see it, and spent months anxious about the outcome. Never given a title.

entities.name: Joanna's second screenplay

properties.aliases: my second script; the road-trip script

entities.description: Joanna's second screenplay, started on 25 February 2022 and finished by 18 March 2022: a thirty-year-old woman on a journey of self-discovery after a loss who takes a road trip to heal and grow, drawn from Joanna's own experience. Identified with the road-trip script she was filming herself in November 2022, and with the script whose self-discovery elements the producers liked at the meetings of 4 November 2022 — the themes, the road trip and the dates all match. Never given a title.

entities.name: Joanna's third screenplay
entities.description: The screenplay Joanna finished on 20 May 2022, which Nate counted as her third. It is about loss, identity and connection, a personal story she had held for years and finally had the courage to write. She submitted it to a film contest on 24 June 2022 and was rejected by a production company shortly before 21 October 2022. Kept separate from Finding Home, the script she was writing with her writers group at the same time, because that one is described throughout as the group's work and this one as solo and personal; never given a title.

entities.name: Finding Home
entities.description: A script about a girl on a journey to find her true home, which Joanna was writing with her writers group in April 2022 and found rewarding and emotional. The only one of her scripts that is given a title.

entities.name: Joanna's book
entities.description: A book Joanna started writing shortly before 10 July 2022, after a film she wrote for did well; it explores loss, redemption and forgiveness. She had never tried to publish a book before. She shared it with her writers group in the week before 22 August 2022 and got good feedback, and finished writing it in the week before 6 October 2022 after many late nights and edits.

entities.name: Joanna's Midwestern thriller script

properties.aliases: my next script; a suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town

entities.description: The script Joanna researched on her July 2022 road trip to Woodhaven, a small town in the Midwest whose history sparked ideas for it, and which she described in November 2022 as a suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town and a great creative outlet. The July mentions of her next script and the November project are taken as one thing: the setting, the research and the dates line up and nothing separates them. Never given a title.

entities.name: Joanna's love story script
entities.description: A film script Joanna was writing in November 2022: a love story with many challenges, the idea for which came to her in a dream. She had finished its introduction by 7 November 2022 and included in it a letter her brother wrote her as a child. Kept apart from the Midwestern thriller she described two days later, which is a different genre and setting.

claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: As of 20 May 2022 Joanna said her allergies meant she did not really want a pet, and that she was too lazy to research alternative pets that might suit her.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna gets through hard times with writing and creative projects, and is grateful for supportive friends who understand her work and give her feedback.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna finished her third screenplay on 20 May 2022, which she called a wild journey.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna's third screenplay is about loss, identity and connection; it was a deeply personal story she had held for years and only then found the courage to write, and Nate observed that she likes writing about sadness and loss.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna says she writes best when she is being true to herself, and that meaningful stories come from personal experience even when it is frightening to dig into it.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Shortly before 25 May 2022 Nate met a couple who live close by while walking Max, found they had a dog too, and arranged dog playdates with them.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate said the couple he met while dog-walking had little in common with him beyond a love of animals, and that this was enough to make them good friends.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate enjoys watching Max play with the neighbours' dog and called seeing his dog so happy a dream come true.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: On 25 May 2022 Nate gave Joanna a stuffed toy dog to remind her of good feelings, and she said she would cherish it.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna and Nate agreed that small things such as the stuffed toy are worth appreciating and are what make life better.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna said the hard moments of finishing her screenplay were what made the journey worth it, and she looked forward to showing the finished script to Nate because she values his opinion.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna received a rejection letter from a major company for a screenplay she had finished, shortly before 3 June 2022, and it left her disheartened.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: The rejection Joanna received in mid-2022 was a generic letter with no feedback, which she found disheartening because she did not know why it had not worked out, but she said she would not let it bring her down.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate won a regional video game tournament in the week before 3 June 2022, met new people there, and said the win was a confidence boost that showed his hard work had paid off.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: By June 2022 Joanna had been hearing about Nate's tournaments for years, and Nate remarked on how long it had been since his first one.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Gamers Nate met at the regional tournament in June 2022 asked to hang out later and asked him for tips on improving their play, which he agreed to give because he likes helping people.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna planned to hike a new trail with a waterfall with friends over the weekend of 4 and 5 June 2022.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate planned a gaming party for the weekend of 18 and 19 June 2022, inviting friends from the tournament along with old friends and former teammates, and giving every guest a custom controller decoration.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: A screenplay Joanna wrote parts of appeared on the big screen on 4 June 2022; she found it nerve-wracking but inspiring to see her words come alive.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna's favourite superhero is Spider-Man, for Peter Parker's struggle between being a hero and being a person, though she likes superheroes generally; Nate had noticed a Spider-Man pin on her purse.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate's favourite superhero is Iron Man, for his technology and sarcastic humour; he keeps an Iron Man figure in his room because it reminds him of something he loves and to keep working on his goals.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna keeps a cork board in her room full of inspiring quotes, photographs and keepsakes, which she calls her little corner of inspiration.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: A photograph of Joanna's family hangs on her cork board and reminds her every day of their love and encouragement.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: On 5 June 2022 Nate said Joanna's cork board sounded valuable enough that he should start one of his own.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna submitted her most recent screenplay to a film contest on 24 June 2022, just to see how others would respond to it.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate's gaming party was a success, and the guests played chess afterwards for fun.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Most of the guests at Nate's June 2022 gaming party liked the controller accessories he gave them, though he did not expect all of them to keep using them and said the thought was what mattered.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Seven people attended Nate's June 2022 gaming party and six of them said they would want to do it again the following month.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate made vegan ice cream on 17 June 2022 and shared it with people in his vegan diet group.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate agreed on 24 June 2022 to give Joanna his vegan ice cream recipe the following day.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna planned to make Nate's vegan ice cream for her family over the weekend of 25 and 26 June 2022, saying they love it when she makes them new things.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna's writing life widened between April and June 2022: she joined a writers group on 21 April, wrote the script Finding Home with them, finished her third screenplay on 20 May, saw a screenplay she had contributed to reach the big screen on 4 June, and submitted her latest to a film contest on 24 June.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate won his fourth video game tournament on 8 July 2022, an online one, and said he was proud to be making money doing what he loves.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna took a road trip in early July 2022 as research for her next film, calling it a much-needed break and a chance to explore new places and get inspired.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna's July 2022 road trip took her to Woodhaven, a small town in the Midwest, where she saw the scenery and historic buildings and visited the library for its old book collection.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: At the Woodhaven library Joanna found a book from the 1900s containing stories and sketches about the town and the people who lived there.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna said Woodhaven's interesting past and how much the town had changed sparked ideas for her next script.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna described the script she began after her July 2022 road trip as different from her previous work and said she was excited about its potential.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna started writing a book shortly before 10 July 2022, after her film did well; the pages she showed Nate held dialogue exploring loss, redemption and forgiveness.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna had never tried to publish a book before, and said the one she started in July 2022 might be her first.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: By 14 August 2022 Joanna was going all out on her writing projects, described the period as a mix of highs and lows, and called her journal her rock.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna says writing is an escape and a way to express her feelings, turning her thoughts into something good, and that words have a magical way of healing.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: In the week before 14 August 2022 a stranger wrote Joanna a letter after reading a blog post she had published about a hard moment in her life, saying her story had brought them comfort; she found it moving proof that her words had power.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna says knowing her writing can make a difference to readers is what keeps her going on tough days.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate started teaching other people how to make dairy-free desserts in the weeks before 14 August 2022 and found sharing that fun and rewarding.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate had a new dairy-free dessert recipe in August 2022, which he described as creamy and rich, and he sent it to Joanna so she could surprise her family with it.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate won an international video game tournament on 21 August 2022 and said gaming had brought him enough success to make a living from something he is passionate about.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate's turtles got a new and larger tank by 22 August 2022, giving them much more room, and he said the expansion had made them happy; he finds coming home to them better after a long day of gaming.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna shared her book with her writers group in the week before 22 August 2022; she was very nervous but received great feedback.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna celebrated the good feedback on her book in August 2022 by making herself a dessert.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate planned to take the weekend of 27 and 28 August 2022 off to relax with his pets.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna planned to spend the weekend of 27 and 28 August 2022 relaxing and recharging with a long walk and some reading.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna says she has learned that taking breaks and looking after herself matter for her inspiration and her mental health, and that it is all about balance.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: On 22 August 2022 Joanna advised Nate to find a fantasy book series to read, saying fiction series are good for relaxing, and he picked one out.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate recommended a book series of his own to Joanna on 22 August 2022, praising its battles, characters, action scenes and plot and calling it one of his favourites.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate did badly in a video game tournament shortly before 5 September 2022, which he called a setback and part of the learning curve; spending time with his turtles helped him stay positive.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: By 5 September 2022 Joanna was revising one of her old dessert recipes and several others, and said tinkering with them gave her comfort and a creative outlet.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna was experimenting with chocolate, raspberry and coconut flavours in her desserts in September 2022.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna bakes only dairy-free because she is lactose intolerant, using coconut or almond milk, and in September 2022 made dairy-free chocolate coconut cupcakes with raspberry frosting.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna makes cookies, pies and cakes that suit everyone's diets and promised in September 2022 to share more recipes with Nate.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate asked to bake with Joanna sometime, saying cooking and baking bring people together, and she welcomed the idea of a fellow chef in the kitchen.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate's tips for dairy-free baking are to use dairy-free margarine or coconut oil in place of butter and to check labels to be sure ingredients are dairy-free.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna's laptop crashed in the week before 14 September 2022 and she lost all her work; nothing was recoverable, which she called a major blow because her laptop is half her lifeline as a writer.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: After losing her work in September 2022 Joanna bought an external drive to back up her writing, saying she never wants to go through it again.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate taught people vegan ice cream recipes on his own cooking show on 12 September 2022; he found it nerve-wracking to put himself out there but a blast, and picked up a few new recipes.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate's favourite dish from his cooking show is coconut milk ice cream, which he describes as smooth and creamy with a tropical twist and suitable for vegans and the lactose intolerant; he offered Joanna the recipe.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna made a dessert with almond milk on 9 September 2022 and said it was good.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Besides coconut milk ice cream, Nate also loves dairy-free chocolate mousse, which he says is creamy and tastes like the real thing.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna's favourite dairy-free treat as of September 2022 was a chocolate raspberry tart with an almond flour crust, chocolate ganache and fresh raspberries.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna's dairy-free chocolate cake with raspberries is made with almond flour, coconut oil, chocolate and raspberries, and is the one she makes for birthdays and special days.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna also makes a dessert with blueberries, coconut milk and a gluten-free crust, which she shared with Nate in September 2022.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna tried her newest dairy-free recipe on 5 October 2022 and it was a winner with her family.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate won a very big video game tournament in the week before 6 October 2022 and made a large amount of money from it.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate saved some of his October 2022 prize money without a particular plan for it, saying he is completely content and glad simply to have the extra cash and not to have to worry about money.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate watched Little Women shortly before 6 October 2022 and thought the acting and the story were great; Joanna had recommended it to him in February 2022 and had also watched it herself.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna finished writing her book in the week before 6 October 2022, after many late nights and edits, and was proud of it.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate made Joanna a hand-drawn whiteboard of encouragement in October 2022 so she could look back on it whenever she needed it, saying encouragement was what had carried his own gaming career.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna finished a handmade bookmark on 6 October 2022 for one of the women in her writing club, and said she loves DIY projects and knows the recipient does too.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate went to a game convention on 7 October 2022 and met people from outside his usual circle; he found it a little overwhelming but was reminded of the good times gaming brings.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate made friends at the October 2022 game convention who share his love of games, and they arranged a gaming session together.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: At the October 2022 convention Nate joined a group playing a board game he loves and hit it off with them over the shared hobby.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: The board game Nate played at the October 2022 convention was Catan, a strategy game of building settlements and trading resources, which he says can be played either competitively or in a relaxed way; his group competed but had fun.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate says games are his escape from life's struggles, so he does not get very competitive about them, and the people at the October 2022 convention were the same way.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: On 9 October 2022 Nate suggested Joanna go to a writing convention, and she said she did not know whether they existed but would look into it.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate unwinds at home by playing video games or watching films.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate watched Inception shortly before 9 October 2022 and said its twists and dream premise blew his mind, and he was playing Cyberpunk 2077 constantly for its futuristic setting and gameplay.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna watched a classic film shortly before 9 October 2022 with a gripping story and great actors, which stuck with her; she rated it nine or ten out of ten.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate and Joanna both say films take them to other worlds and make them feel things they would not normally experience, and are a good way to wind down.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna has a comfortable living room she likes watching films in and prefers it to a cinema, saying a soft couch and a good blanket leave her at peace.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: On 9 October 2022 Joanna advised Nate to make his living room comfortable with a large soft couch he can lie down on, a slightly weighted blanket and dimmable lights, and said she gets deeply invested in small details like that.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate's competitive gaming turned into a livelihood over 2022: he won his fourth tournament online on 8 July, an international tournament on 21 August and a big-money tournament in early October, and by August was saying he made a living from it.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: By 21 October 2022 Joanna had revised and perfected the dessert recipe she had made for her family, and it turned out really tasty.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate was stressed in October 2022 about his progress in tournaments against tough competitors, and said his turtles always cheer him up.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna named the stuffed toy dog Nate gave her Tilly, and keeps her close while she writes.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna named the stuffed dog Tilly after a dog of the same name she had in Michigan, which the family had to give up when she developed her allergy; the name reminds her of when she could hold animals without reacting.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna says Tilly the stuffed dog helps her stay focused and brings her joy, and Nate said much the same of watching his turtles walk around.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate was practising for his next video game tournament in October 2022.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna had another rejection from a production company shortly before 21 October 2022, for the screenplay she had sent to a film contest in June.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna said the October 2022 rejection was hard but would not slow her down, and that she would keep pushing forward and believing in herself.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: A film made from a script Joanna contributed to was shown on the big screen for the first time on 23 October 2022; she called it a surreal and satisfying experience she had waited a long time for, and said it was the third time it had happened.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna said her favourite part of seeing her work filmed in October 2022 was watching the characters she had worked so hard on come alive, as if they had jumped off the page.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna draws pictures of her characters as visuals to bring them alive in her head so that she can write them better.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna takes her character ideas from everywhere — people she knows, things she has seen and things she imagines — and enjoys watching an idea take shape into a person with their own wants and worries.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna refused to tell Nate about a character from her October 2022 film and told him to watch it instead, which made him keener to see it.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate took his turtles out for a walk on 25 October 2022 because he was bored, and they rested in their tank afterwards.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate's turtles eat a varied diet of vegetables, fruit and insects.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate most enjoys watching his turtles eat fruit, which excites them, and he also likes holding them.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate's turtles have distinct personalities: one is more adventurous and the other more reserved, and he says they make great companions.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate has liked turtles since he was a boy and says he knows all about them; Joanna said his turtles had made her find turtles interesting for the first time.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna set up meetings with film producers and they had taken place by 4 November 2022; she felt confident discussing her script and her vision and the producers seemed interested and excited.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: The producers Joanna met in November 2022 particularly liked the self-discovery elements of her script, which she found validating and which left her hopeful and inspired about the future.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna found old notebooks of her early writing in the week before 4 November 2022 and enjoyed seeing how far she had come.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna still remembers a story she wrote at the age of ten about a brave little turtle who was scared but explored the world anyway, and says courage and risk-taking are still themes in her writing.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: As of 4 November 2022 Joanna was working on a project she found challenging but fulfilling, alongside her producer meetings.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: In early November 2022 Nate was helping friends reset their high scores at the international tournament, and said it felt good to use his skills to make a difference.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate made lactose-free coconut milk ice cream on 3 November 2022 and invited Joanna over to try it.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna arranged to visit Nate on 5 November 2022 and to bring her own dessert recipes, including the chocolate and raspberry cake he had been wanting to try.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate reached the final of a big Valorant tournament on 5 November 2022 and won it, saying seeing his name as the champion was the best feeling and that tournaments bring out strong emotions in him.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna finished her presentation for producers on 4 November 2022 and said it had been tough but was looking good.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: As of 7 November 2022 Nate was busy preparing for further tournaments and said he was grateful to have a job he enjoys every day.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: In November 2022 Joanna was writing another film script, a love story with many challenges that she hoped to get onto the big screen; the idea came to her in a dream.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate said his turtles were doing well in November 2022 and that watching them is calming and fascinating and that he has grown very fond of them.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna says creating stories and watching them come alive is what gives her happiness and fulfilment, and calls writing a blessing.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna submitted several more scripts in the week before 7 November 2022 and expected a few of them to be rejected.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate upgraded some of his home gaming equipment shortly before 7 November 2022, and uses the setup to practise, to compete and sometimes to play with friends.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate calls his gaming setup his own little haven and says it is essential to his career, because without it he could not beat his competition.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: In November 2022 Nate was playing the Japanese fantasy RPG Xenoblade Chronicles, which friends had recommended and which he had wanted to play for a while; he is a big fan of Nintendo games and recommended it to Joanna.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna finished the introduction to her next film script by 7 November 2022 and included in it a letter her brother wrote her when they were children.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna's brother used to write her cute notes when they were children, and they bring back sweet memories of simpler times for her.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate remembers a special day when he took his pets to the park and their happiness made it memorable, and says he treasures mixing new memories with old ones.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna had started writing down her favourite memories by 7 November 2022, and Nate said he would start doing the same, including memories with Joanna and notes on what his animals like.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate's game tournament was pushed back in early November 2022, so he cooked instead and made homemade coconut ice cream whose colour was changed by the sprinkles.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate did not make the finals of his last tournament before 9 November 2022, calling it a tough one, but said he would get them next time.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate had several offers from gaming teams as of 9 November 2022 and was thinking of joining a new team after his next tournament, but had not yet decided.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna made a plan for getting one of her scripts produced as a film and pitched it to producers on 8 November 2022; they really liked it and it gave her a big confidence boost.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: In November 2022 Joanna began a new project: a suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town, which she called a great creative outlet.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate started creating gaming content for YouTube in November 2022, as a way to entertain people and satisfy his appetite for games when there are no tournaments on.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate is a fan of gaming videos himself and hoped his own channel would let him share his love of gaming and connect with others who enjoy it.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna advised Nate to watch other people's gaming videos first so his own would suit what his audience likes, and he said he was already doing that.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna photographed a sunflower field at sunset while hiking near Fort Wayne in the summer of 2022, and called it a reminder of nature's beauty.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate bought a third turtle from a pet store by 9 November 2022, after seeing it and deciding the tank was now big enough for three; he said he was very happy with the decision.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna arranged to visit Nate on 10 November 2022 to watch him play with his turtles from a distance because of her allergy; he offered to bathe them beforehand and suggested watching one of her films or going to the park.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna was filming her own movie, made from her road-trip screenplay, by 11 November 2022.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Joanna said every day on the set of her film was full of potential and that being able to show her own vision was wonderful.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: One of the actors on Joanna's film came up to her and told her how much she liked the script, which Joanna described as the coolest moment on set.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate took his turtles to the beach in Tampa on 10 November 2022, and said they bring him peace in the craziness of life.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate says he loves having his turtles around because they make him feel calm, need little looking after, and he enjoys watching them soak in the sun.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Nate calls turtles zen masters who remind him to slow down and appreciate the small things in life.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: In November 2022 Nate was experimenting with flavours and mix-ins in his coconut milk ice cream, and offered Joanna the new recipe to try.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna's second screenplay went the whole way from page to set during 2022: started on 25 February as a road-trip story of self-discovery, finished by 18 March, taken to producer meetings on 4 November where its self-discovery elements were what they liked, pitched on 8 November, and being filmed by Joanna herself by 11 November.
claims.speaker: Joanna

claims.text: Nate's household grew over 2022: he had kept two turtles since about 2019, adopted a dog called Max by 20 May 2022, and added a third turtle by 9 November 2022.
claims.speaker: Nate

claims.text: Joanna's rejections and her breakthroughs ran side by side in 2022: a generic rejection from a major company before 3 June and another from a production company before 21 October, against three screenplays finished, a book written, three films she contributed to reaching the screen, and producers taking her own script in November.
claims.speaker: Joanna
